message.content:
C♯ major has **seven sharps** in its key signature:

| Sharp | Note |
|-------|------|
| F♯   | F♯ |
| C♯   | C♯ |
| G♯   | G♯ |
| D♯   | D♯ |
| A♯   | A♯ |
| E♯   | E♯ |
| B♯   | B♯ |

So the key signature for C♯ major is the same as that of the key of G♯ minor (the relative minor), with all seven accidentals marked as sharps.
